name: UMMC
note: Club sponsor of HC Avtomobilist per the club's sponsors page (archived capture of 8 July 2025; the page footer calls ОАО «УГМК» the club's general sponsor). UMMC also holds arena naming rights (УГМК Арена). Founded and owned by Iskander Makhmudov per US Treasury (September 2023); US/UK/NZ sanctions are not human-rights findings under the method. Left UNRATED on the company test: Rostekhnadzor's Ural department completed an investigation of a 10 October 2025 serious accident at PJSC Nadezhdinsky Metallurgical Plant (a UMMC company) that injured a worker, found safety violations and held officials administratively liable under Art. 9.1(3) KoAP (December 2025, https://www.business-humanrights.org/en/latest-news/russia-worker-injured-at-nadezhdinsky-metallurgical-plant-due-to-industrial-safety-violations/ citing Rostekhnadzor); in August 2021 a worker was killed by a rock collapse at UMMC's Korbalikhinsky mine (JSC Siberia-Polymetals) and a criminal case was opened under Art. 217(2) of the Criminal Code (Interfax, https://www.business-humanrights.org/en/latest-news/russia-worker-killed-in-accident-at-korbalikhinsky-mine-criminal-case-initiated/). A maintainer should judge whether the regulator's finding passes METHOD.md's company test.
